'''Galven cylinders''' were weapon components used in [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptors]]. Each weapon used a number of galven cylinders in their design, where they were placed along the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. The components were used to tightly focus the disruptor beam, effectively concentrating the high-energy particles into one devastating blast.<ref name="EGWT" />
